The error "cannot attach stdin to a TTY-enabled container because stdin is not a terminal" happens when:

3. Or simply start containers without stdin_open

content.text:
# Architecture (one LLM, no "two models"):
# - ollama: only container that uses GPU; runs the model. /api/tags, /api/show, and
#   chat requests (from the gateway) go here.
# - mcp: CPU only. Two processes in one container (two ports): 8000 = MCP protocol (Emacs),
#   8001 = FastAPI agent (control UI, tool-injecting chat, health, vision). Nginx exposes
#   both under /mcp: /mcp → 8000, /mcp/* → 8001. Chat is forwarded to ollama.
# - nginx: /mcp and /mcp/* → mcp container; / and /api/* → ollama.
# Parallel: set OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL to 2+ if your GPU has room; 1 is safest for small VRAM.
# control panel: https://ollama.jetson/mcp/control/
# All config is in this file for debugging.

services:
  mcp-server:
    build:
      context: ./
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
        #image: jetson-mcp:latest
    #container_name: mcp-server
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./:/app
      - mcp_data:/app/data  # response_log.db when options.log_response is set (overrides host dir)
    privileged: true
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_HOST=http://ollama:11434
      - OLLAMA_NUM_GPU=20
      - OLLAMA_NUM_CTX=1024
      - MCP_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0
      # - MCP_AGENT_DEBUG=1
      - MCP_HTTP_PORT=8002
      # One request at a time to Ollama; wait up to 5s for VRAM capacity
      - OLLAMA_AGENT_MAX_CONCURRENT=1
      - OLLAMA_CAPACITY_WAIT=5
      # Retry Ollama on runner crash/OOM: 3 attempts, 5s delay (then 503)
      - OLLAMA_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=3
      - OLLAMA_RETRY_DELAY=5
      # VRAM gate: don't forward if Ollama already uses this many bytes (6 GiB). Set to empty to disable.
      - OLLAMA_MAX_VRAM_BYTES=6442450944
      # Smaller model for the tool loop (from /api/tags). Use the most suited of what we have, e.g. llama3.2:1b.
      - OLLAMA_TOOL_MODEL=llama3.2:1b
      # When payload options.log_response or log_response is true, store Q&A in SQLite here (join on req_id with perf logs).
      - OLLAMA_RESPONSE_LOG_DB=/app/data/response_log.db
      # Camera (cam0): index 0 = /dev/video0. Vision model for describing the scene (e.g. llava, moondream).
      - CAMERA_INDEX=0
      - OLLAMA_VISION_MODEL="llava"
    networks:
      - webserver-net
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 384M
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/health')"]
      interval: 60s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 25s

  mcp-client:
    build:
      context: ../mcp-client
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - webserver-net
    
networks:
  webserver-net:
    name: webserver_webserver-net
    driver: bridge
    external: true

volumes:
  mcp_data:   # /app/data in mcp (response_log.db for eval)

    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    networks:
      - webserver-net
    depends_on:
      mcp:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
